src/prometheist/model_residency.py::prev.rationale: Reclaim estimates accept only nonnegative reported system memory; forecasts never authorize execution.

src/prometheist/runtime_job.py::main::sl.rationale: Local app input, preview, listing, model-generation, polling and resource bounds are explicit provisional controls. Existing evidence/admission defaults are preserved; host and model-specific calibration is required. See docs/experiments/LOCAL_APP_001.md.

structural.rationale: Domain, protocol, sentinel, or representation constraint required for deterministic validity; it is not an empirical optimization knob.

external.rationale: Numeric shape is dictated by an external operating-system data format rather than chosen as Prometheist policy.

memory_score.rationale: Memory cue weighting, temporal scaling, score threshold, and direct-support admission are quality tradeoffs. The frozen corpus proves the current policy works but does not uniquely justify these exact values.

memory_lexical.rationale: Lexical normalization/token heuristics affect recall and false-positive behavior; they remain provisional until varied against the same frozen/adversarial memory-quality benchmark.

memory_breadth.rationale: The frozen breadth sweep proves the current packet limit is correct but quality-equivalent to limits 3 through 24; other production breadth layers remain unmeasured at discriminating scale.

memory_graph.rationale: The frozen graph sweep found 120 quality-equivalent hop/decay policies, including a one-hop alternative, and does not discriminate loader/profile breadth; exact graph budgets remain unidentified.

cap_discovery.rationale: All five materially different coefficient vectors preserve the current routing oracles, so the production discovery coefficients and breadth are not uniquely justified by present evidence.

scheduler_service.rationale: Quarter-, half-, current-, double-, and quadruple-scaled wait vectors all preserve the deterministic service-order invariant; without measured workload arrival distributions and queue-delay SLAs, exact waits and priority spacing remain unidentified.

resource_native.rationale: Observation freshness, host headroom, process estimates, probe timing, and local-LLM concurrency depend on measured behavior of the target host and cannot be established by Ubuntu CI.

worker_native.rationale: Lease, timeout, retry, and post-kill wait values depend on measured worker/process tails and fault-recovery behavior on the target Windows host.

llm_native.rationale: Ollama HTTP timing, output caps, retry counts, literal-preservation bounds, and response-temperature policy depend on supported local-model behavior and target-host performance.

ollama_runtime.rationale: Ollama running-model probe timing is target-runtime dependent. Residency semantics are structural, while the probe timeout remains a native measurement obligation.

perception_representation.rationale: SHA-256 hexadecimal digests contain exactly 64 characters; uppercase ratios lie in [0,1]; salience-v1 defines an ordinal score domain of 0 through 3. These representation bounds do not establish the correctness of scoring thresholds.

perception_buffers.rationale: Inherited v0.8 segment, segment-count, and advisory-label bounds trade context coverage against transport cost. They are provisional, not empirically optimized.

perception_thresholds.rationale: Legacy lexical scoring was removed. Its original implementation remains in the v0.8 parent commit as the comparison baseline.

situation_representation.rationale: Closed ordinal domains, empty counters, positive pages, and enum cardinalities. These do not select salience cutoffs or execution authority.

situation_budgets.rationale: Provisional local context, media, page, source, and response budgets. Independent of corpus size; no claim of empirical optimum. Tune each mechanism separately against SITUATION-PIPELINE-001.

situation_lifetimes.rationale: Provisional bounded heartbeat suspicion, guarded claim lifetime, process lifetime, and post-kill wait. A suspect lease cannot authorize a kill; only an owned timed-out handle can. Calibrate on the intended host.

artifact_journal_projection.rationale: SHA-256 digests are exactly 64 hexadecimal characters by construction of the fixed 256-bit hash output, so blob_store rejects any other length outright. The two-character shard prefix is a fixed content-addressed storage layout convention (mirroring the OCI/git loose-object sharding pattern) chosen for directory fan-out, not a quality tradeoff. The audit renderer's preview-text bound only constrains how many characters of an already-decided field appear on one human-readable timeline line in a non-authoritative projection; it does not gate, weight, or select any cognitive, retrieval, or safety decision, so no benchmark can discriminate among candidate values. journal_signing's 16-hex-character key id is a truncated SHA-256 fingerprint used only as a human-readable lookup/display label for a local keypair; the actual cryptographic verification always uses the full untruncated public key bytes, so the truncation length is a display/representation choice with no bearing on signature correctness or forgeability.

self_memory.rationale: Self-memory activation breadth, reflection packet/output bounds, and schema-promotion evidence thresholds trade person-fidelity coverage against unsupported generalization and local inference cost. The current values are conservative engineering defaults and must be calibrated against frozen self-memory/person-fidelity scenarios rather than treated as neurobiologically or empirically optimal.
